## Clause Navigator (CN)

The table of contents a reviewer needs: clauses grouped by type, each row carrying deviation severity so the eye lands on what moved away from standard language. Render-only over resolved ContractClause instances plus an open callback; mounted inside Contract Workspace.

### Args

`@clauses` (ContractClause[]) — already-resolved instances; the block runs no query of its own, so a consumer can feed it any subset (one contract, one clause type, a template's standard set). `@onOpen(clause)` — the consumer decides what a click does.

### Consumers

Contract Workspace (the contract's clauses). Second consumer: Contract Template could mount it over its standard clauses — same rows, no deviations.

### Non-goals

No text diffing against the standard clause (deviationSeverity is recorded judgment, not computed). No editing.
